name: Lungeo-Comment-Email-Whitelist
author: Richard Assweiler

sections.description:
Lungeo-Comment-Email-Whitelist allows site administrators to exempt selected email addresses from the normal comment moderation queue.

When a new comment is submitted using an email address on the whitelist, the plugin approves it automatically if WordPress would otherwise hold it for moderation.

Comments from all other email addresses continue to follow the site’s existing WordPress moderation settings.

Features:
* Add multiple email addresses to a whitelist.
* Manage the list under Settings > Comment Whitelist.
* Enter one email address per line.
* Email matching is case-insensitive.
* Invalid email addresses are discarded when the list is saved.
* Remove addresses by deleting them from the list and saving.

Compatibility

Requires WordPress 5.8 or later and PHP 7.4 or later. The plugin uses the WordPress pre_comment_approved filter.

The plugin’s PHP syntax has been checked. Compatibility with every theme, plugin combination, hosting configuration, and future WordPress release has not been independently tested.
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Select the plugin ZIP file and upload it.
  3. Activate “Lungeo-Comment-Email-Whitelist”.
  4. Go to Settings > Comment Whitelist.
  5. Enter one email address per line.
  6. Click “Whitelist speichern” (Save Whitelist).
sections.faq:
Will every comment from a whitelisted address be approved?

The plugin approves a comment from a whitelisted address when WordPress has marked it for moderation. It does not override comments already marked as spam or trash, and it does not change comments that WordPress has already approved.

Do other commenters bypass moderation?

No. Comments from addresses that are not on the whitelist continue to follow your existing WordPress moderation settings.

Does the plugin verify that the commenter owns the email address?

No. WordPress comment forms generally do not prove ownership of the entered email address. Only whitelist addresses you trust. Consider additional identity or anti-spam verification if needed.

How do I remove an address?

Go to Settings > Comment Whitelist, delete the address from the text area, and save the settings.
